items_all.title: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
items_all.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF builds start at 1.56 GB, and the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture loads in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and MLX without a model-code fork. The post OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenBMB 發布了 MiniCPM5-2B，這是一個擁有 2,516,756,480 個參數以及原生 131,072 個 Token 內容視窗的密集型因果語言模型。在其模型卡片的 34 個基準測試中，它的平均得分達到 53.9，領先於 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，其中在工具使用、編碼代理（coding agents）和長文本檢索方面的優勢最為明顯。後訓練（post-training）將 4000 億（400B）個 Token 的深度思考 SFT 與 RL 教師模型相結合，並透過線上策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation）將 16 個專家模型合併為一個檢查點。此權重採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，同時提供的還有預訓練、SFT 與 RL 資料集，以及中繼的 Base、Midtrain 和 SFT-only 檢查點。GGUF 建置版本大小從 1.56 GB 起跳，且標準的 LlamaForCausalLM 架構可在 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 和 MLX 中載入，無需進行模型程式碼分支。這篇 OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
items_all.summary: Anthropic signed compute contracts worth up to $517 billion in eleven months but still trails OpenAI's $750 billion plan through 2030. In early 2026, CEO Dario Amodei warned against investing too fast. Now Anthropic is racing to catch up, while Sam Altman warns about "unsustainable silliness" in the compute buildout, especially from neo-cloud providers. The article Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 11 個月內簽署了高達 5,170 億美元的運算合約，但其 2030 年前的規模仍落後於 OpenAI's 的 7,500 億美元計畫。2026 年初，執行長 Dario Amodei 曾警告不要投資過快。現在 Anthropic 正急起直追，而 Sam Altman 則警告運算基礎設施建設中存在「不可持續的荒謬現象」，特別是來自新雲端服務供應商的建設。這篇題為〈Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk〉的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all.title: GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish without human help in under 24 hours
items_all.summary: GPT-6 Astra beat the puzzle game Portal entirely on its own in about 24 hours, with zero human help after the initial goal was set. Developer cozyblaze published the code and docs on GitHub. His takeaway: Astra is "the worst model we'll ever get." The article GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish without human help in under 24 hours appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra 在設定初始目標後，完全不靠人類協助，在約 24 小時內獨立通關了益智遊戲《傳送門》（Portal）。開發者 cozyblaze 已將程式碼與文件發布至 GitHub。他的結論是：Astra 是「我們未來會用到的所有模型中最差的一個」。本文 GPT-6 Astra beat Portal start to finish without human help in under 24 hours 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades
items_all.summary: ChatGPT has pushed its share of AI chatbot website traffic back up to 55.5 percent, according to Similarweb. Year-over-year, though, its lead shrank sharply from 73.3 percent as Gemini doubled its share and Claude grew nearly fivefold. Mobile apps and desktop clients aren't included. The article ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 Similarweb 的數據，ChatGPT 已將其 AI 聊天機器人網站流量佔有率推回 55.5%。不過，與去年同期相比，其領先優勢從 73.3% 大幅縮水，因為 Gemini 的佔有率倍增，而 Claude 則成長了近五倍。行動應用程式和桌面客戶端不包含在內。本文 ChatGPT claws back web traffic share to 55.5 percent as Gemini's brief comeback fades 最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial
items_all.summary: A study in Nature Biotechnology suggests that rentosertib, a drug designed with AI by Insilico Medicine, may reverse markers of biological aging. Six independent aging clocks predicted that treated patients were biologically up to six years younger than the placebo group. The trial covered just 42 patients and the drug hasn't been tested in healthy people yet. The article AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 發表於《自然生物科技》（Nature Biotechnology）的一項研究表明，由 Insilico Medicine 利用 AI 設計的藥物 rentosertib 可能有助於逆轉生物老化指標。六個獨立的老年鐘（aging clocks）預測，接受治療的患者在生物學上比安慰劑組年輕最多六年。該試驗僅涵蓋 42 名患者，且該藥物尚未在健康人群中進行測試。本文 AI-designed drug appears to turn back the body's biological clock in early trial 最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job
items_all.summary: Swiss banking giant UBS is making AI skills a required qualification from 2027 for graduates and interns in Global Banking and Markets, with applicants having to show in interviews how they use AI to improve outcomes and efficiency. Santander is already looking for advanced AI users too, while Morgan Stanley predicts more than 200,000 banking jobs in Europe will disappear within five years. The article At UBS, AI skills are now a condition for landing a job appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 瑞士銀行巨頭瑞銀（UBS）將 AI 技能列為 2027 年起全球銀行與市場部門畢業生和實習生的必備資格，申請人必須在面試中展示他們如何利用 AI 來改善成果與效率。桑坦德銀行（Santander）也已經在尋找具備進階 AI 能力的使用者，而摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）則預測，五年內歐洲將有超過 20 萬個銀行職位消失。「在瑞銀，AI 技能現在是獲得工作的條件」一文最先發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: OpenAI Reports AI "Research Interns" and Warns Against Moving Too Fast
items_all.summary: OpenAI reports that AI agents in its own research already handle 3.1 workdays for every human workday, and it says it has reached its goal of an "automated research intern." But chief scientist Pachocki warns that no lab has a good enough grip on alignment and monitoring to keep scaling at maximum speed. The article OpenAI Reports AI "Research Interns" and Warns Against Moving Too Fast appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 報導稱，其自身研究中的 AI 代理對於每個人類工作天已能處理 3.1 個工作天，並表示已達成實現「自動化研究實習生」的目標。但首席科學家 Pachocki 警告稱，沒有任何實驗室能對齊與監控有夠好的掌控力，以維持最高速度繼續擴展。這篇題為 OpenAI Reports AI "Research Interns" and Warnings Against Moving Too Fast 的文章最早發布於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver
items_all.summary: Alibaba's research arm has released Qwen-Drive 1.0, an AI model that handles environmental perception, traffic Q&A, and route planning in one system. The researchers show that text-image models don't automatically understand three-dimensional space. Spatial awareness has to be trained on purpose. The goal is a single model that runs both the cockpit and the driving system. The article Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴的 研究部門已發布 Qwen-Drive 1.0，這是一個在單一系統中處理環境感知、交通問答與路徑規劃的 AI 模型。研究人員指出，文字-圖片模型無法自動理解三維空間，空間意識必須透過專門訓練來獲得。其目標是打造一個能同時運行智慧座艙與駕駛系統的單一模型。這篇題為〈Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver〉的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all.summary: Most open model launches release one checkpoint and a benchmark table. The Institute of Foundation Models (IFM) released something wider last week. IFM is the frontier lab launched by MBZUAI in May 2025. K2 Horizon is a fleet of six models: 375B-A23B, 36B-A4B, 32B, 7B, 3.7B and 0.9B. Shipping alongside them are the pre-training corpus, […] The post IFM Releases K2 Horizon: Six Apache 2.0 Models From 0.9B to 375B appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 多數開源模型的發表通常只會釋出一個檢查點和基準測試表。基礎模型研究所（IFM）上週發布了規模更廣泛的成果。IFM 是由 MBZUAI 於 2025 年 5 月成立的前沿實驗室。K2 Horizon 是一系列包含六個模型的組合：375B-A23B、36B-A4B、32B、7B、3.7B 和 0.9B。與這些模型一同發布的還有預訓練語料庫，[...] The post IFM Releases K2 Horizon: Six Apache 2.0 Models From 0.9B to 375B appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items_all.title: Creepy crawlies
items_all.summary: Creepy crawlies Konstantin Ryabitsev discusses how bad the "background radiation" of abusive crawlers has become from the perspective of git.kernel.org , the official Git repository for the Linux kernel: TL;DR: we spend more CPU cycles rendering commits for scrapers than we spend on all other kinds of legitimate access, including git clones. At any one time, across 5 geo-distributed nodes, there are 14 CPU cores doing nothing but rendering git commits as html. I worry about this a lot from the perspective of Datasette, which serves a huge number of crawlable web pages. Via Hacker News Tags: crawling , git , linux , datasette , ai-ethics

items_all.title: Quoting Jakub Pachocki
items_all.summary: The strongest argument I see for continuing to train much smarter models quickly is the need to build defensive systems against the dangers posed by other AI. [...] We will need powerful, aligned AI for defense; to secure infrastructure, to protect against rogue agents in real time, and to invent entirely new protective measures. This will be a primary focus of OpenAI’s deployment efforts. At the same time, even with the uncertainty that comes from anticipated broad AI progress and the need to build defensive systems, we must not let that become an excuse for recklessness. The idea of racing forward at all costs seems absurd once one internalizes the seriousness of the stakes. — Jakub Pachocki , Chief Scientist at OpenAI Tags: ai-ethics , openai , ai

items_all_raw.title: HiddenLayer獲得1億美元B輪融資，擴大AI代理執行階段安全防護
items_all_raw.summary: AI資安業者HiddenLayer宣佈完成1億美元B輪融資，將運用這筆資金持續擴充AI安全平臺，並投入工程、研究及業務拓展。 HiddenLayer既有產品涵蓋生成式AI、預測式AI與AI代理，提供資產探索、供應鏈安全、攻擊模擬及執行階段防護等功能。今年則進一步強化AI代理實際執行任務時的安全控管。

items_all_raw.title: Creepy crawlies
items_all_raw.summary: Creepy crawlies Konstantin Ryabitsev discusses how bad the "background radiation" of abusive crawlers has become from the perspective of git.kernel.org , the official Git repository for the Linux kernel: TL;DR: we spend more CPU cycles rendering commits for scrapers than we spend on all other kinds of legitimate access, including git clones. At any one time, across 5 geo-distributed nodes, there are 14 CPU cores doing nothing but rendering git commits as html. I worry about this a lot from the perspective of Datasette, which serves a huge number of crawlable web pages. Via Hacker News Tags: crawling , git , linux , datasette , ai-ethics

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Jakub Pachocki
items_all_raw.summary: The strongest argument I see for continuing to train much smarter models quickly is the need to build defensive systems against the dangers posed by other AI. [...] We will need powerful, aligned AI for defense; to secure infrastructure, to protect against rogue agents in real time, and to invent entirely new protective measures. This will be a primary focus of OpenAI’s deployment efforts. At the same time, even with the uncertainty that comes from anticipated broad AI progress and the need to build defensive systems, we must not let that become an excuse for recklessness. The idea of racing forward at all costs seems absurd once one internalizes the seriousness of the stakes. — Jakub Pachocki , Chief Scientist at OpenAI Tags: ai-ethics , openai , ai

items_all_raw.title: OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device
items_all_raw.summary: OpenBMB has released MiniCPM5-2B, a dense causal language model with 2,516,756,480 parameters and a native 131,072 token context. It averages 53.9 across the 34 benchmarks in its model card, ahead of Qwen3.5-4B at 51.1, with its clearest leads in tool use, coding agents and long-context retrieval. Post-training pairs 400B tokens of deep-thinking SFT with RL teachers and on-policy distillation that merges 16 expert models into one checkpoint. The weights ship under Apache 2.0 alongside the pre-training, SFT and RL datasets and the intermediate Base, Midtrain and SFT-only checkpoints. GGUF builds start at 1.56 GB, and the standard LlamaForCausalLM architecture loads in vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and MLX without a model-code fork. The post OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenBMB 發布了 MiniCPM5-2B，這是一個擁有 2,516,756,480 個參數以及原生 131,072 個 Token 內容視窗的密集型因果語言模型。在其模型卡片的 34 個基準測試中，它的平均得分達到 53.9，領先於 Qwen3.5-4B 的 51.1，其中在工具使用、編碼代理（coding agents）和長文本檢索方面的優勢最為明顯。後訓練（post-training）將 4000 億（400B）個 Token 的深度思考 SFT 與 RL 教師模型相結合，並透過線上策略蒸餾（on-policy distillation）將 16 個專家模型合併為一個檢查點。此權重採用 Apache 2.0 授權發布，同時提供的還有預訓練、SFT 與 RL 資料集，以及中繼的 Base、Midtrain 和 SFT-only 檢查點。GGUF 建置版本大小從 1.56 GB 起跳，且標準的 LlamaForCausalLM 架構可在 vLLM、SGLang、llama.cpp、Ollama 和 MLX 中載入，無需進行模型程式碼分支。這篇 OpenBMB Releases MiniCPM5-2B: A 2.52B Dense Model Averaging 53.9 Across 34 Benchmarks and Built to Run On Device 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI reports that AI agents in its own research already handle 3.1 workdays for every human workday, and it says it has reached its goal of an "automated research intern." But chief scientist Pachocki warns that no lab has a good enough grip on alignment and monitoring to keep scaling at maximum speed. The article OpenAI Reports AI "Research Interns" and Warns Against Moving Too Fast appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 報導稱，其自身研究中的 AI 代理對於每個人類工作天已能處理 3.1 個工作天，並表示已達成實現「自動化研究實習生」的目標。但首席科學家 Pachocki 警告稱，沒有任何實驗室能對齊與監控有夠好的掌控力，以維持最高速度繼續擴展。這篇題為 OpenAI Reports AI "Research Interns" and Warnings Against Moving Too Fast 的文章最早發布於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver
items_all_raw.summary: Alibaba's research arm has released Qwen-Drive 1.0, an AI model that handles environmental perception, traffic Q&A, and route planning in one system. The researchers show that text-image models don't automatically understand three-dimensional space. Spatial awareness has to be trained on purpose. The goal is a single model that runs both the cockpit and the driving system. The article Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴的 研究部門已發布 Qwen-Drive 1.0，這是一個在單一系統中處理環境感知、交通問答與路徑規劃的 AI 模型。研究人員指出，文字-圖片模型無法自動理解三維空間，空間意識必須透過專門訓練來獲得。其目標是打造一個能同時運行智慧座艙與駕駛系統的單一模型。這篇題為〈Qwen-Drive 1.0 tells you why it brakes, just don't expect the explanation to match the maneuver〉的文章最先出現在 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.summary: 美國媒體西雅圖時報與Newsday向紐約南區聯邦地方法院，控告OpenAI與微軟侵犯著作權，指控兩家公司未經授權使用新聞內容訓練AI，並在搜尋與生成回答時取用西雅圖時報與Newsday的報導。兩家媒體要求損害賠償、禁止被指控的侵權行為，並要求法院扣押或銷毀納入西雅圖時報與Newsday新聞內容或衍生內容的大型語言模型與訓練資料集。
